description: Hi! I'm Aryan, a Robotics Engineer (Embedded, Motion Control, Firmware). I led SIH 2025's national winning team (30k+ teams) and led the ISRO CanSat team to the finals in October. I bring hardware, firmware, and C++/Python to build working space-tech prototypes. Seeking Software Devs (Python/JS), ML/Data Scientists, UI/UX, and space enthusiasts. Let's build impactful solutions!
